title: MDP에서 Action-Value function에 대한 Bellman Equation
markdown:
> 🤔 > > > > Action Value function은 Action을 고려한 관계식이다.
즉, action을 고려하지 않는 MRP에서 Action-Value function은 존재하지 않는다. ## MDP <S, A, P, R ,\gamma>에서 Action-Value function에 대한 Bellman Equation --- ### Action Value Function ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/357e00e80429348449bcba14b5ab36c813c9d247/posts/345eda9b-0fe1-8072-bc59-c9ffe2ef81a4/8634db2f3ee8e94f.webp) ### 유도 방법 1 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/357e00e80429348449bcba14b5ab36c813c9d247/posts/345eda9b-0fe1-8072-bc59-c9ffe2ef81a4/bdf3051868092ae4.webp) - A_{t+1}은 Random variable이기 때문에 평균(Expectation)으로 구한다. ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/357e00e80429348449bcba14b5ab36c813c9d247/posts/345eda9b-0fe1-8072-bc59-c9ffe2ef81a4/0e0d31295db36f6f.webp) ### 유도 방법 2 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/357e00e80429348449bcba14b5ab36c813c9d247/posts/345eda9b-0fe1-8072-bc59-c9ffe2ef81a4/6bc4b9f74fe20791.webp) - s_{t+1}에 대한 식 변형 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/357e00e80429348449bcba14b5ab36c813c9d247/posts/345eda9b-0fe1-8072-bc59-c9ffe2ef81a4/a628a2c10104a34e.webp) - s_t, a_t, s_{t+1} 이 주어지면 Reward function을 계산할 수 있다.
즉, 더이상 Random variable이 아닌 상수로써 E_{\pi}[…]을 빠져나올 수 있다. ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/357e00e80429348449bcba14b5ab36c813c9d247/posts/345eda9b-0fe1-8072-bc59-c9ffe2ef81a4/8c4523ba52609421.webp) - a_{t+1}에 대한 식 변형 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/357e00e80429348449bcba14b5ab36c813c9d247/posts/345eda9b-0fe1-8072-bc59-c9ffe2ef81a4/4385acbcf6b839c8.webp) ### 정리 - Bellman equation for Action-Value function ![ • 백업 다이어그램](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/357e00e80429348449bcba14b5ab36c813c9d247/posts/345eda9b-0fe1-8072-bc59-c9ffe2ef81a4/d9089f344e051a0f.webp) ### Bellman equation for Action-Value function ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/357e00e80429348449bcba14b5ab36c813c9d247/posts/345eda9b-0fe1-8072-bc59-c9ffe2ef81a4/e0693ea74a6f31db.webp) ### 예제 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/357e00e80429348449bcba14b5ab36c813c9d247/posts/345eda9b-0fe1-8072-bc59-c9ffe2ef81a4/ebf4f4729f9e17d6.webp) - Q^{\pi}(s_2, a_0) ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/357e00e80429348449bcba14b5ab36c813c9d247/posts/345eda9b-0fe1-8072-bc59-c9ffe2ef81a4/bbb48fd939b92e5a.webp) ## MDP <S, A, P, R ,\gamma>에서 Value function, Action-Value function 관련 수식 --- ### Action-Value function을 활용한 Value function 표현 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/357e00e80429348449bcba14b5ab36c813c9d247/posts/345eda9b-0fe1-8072-bc59-c9ffe2ef81a4/f12ddc13f0b3c6b2.webp) ### Value function을 활용한 Action-Value function 표현 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/357e00e80429348449bcba14b5ab36c813c9d247/posts/345eda9b-0fe1-8072-bc59-c9ffe2ef81a4/32c11b6a27de7982.webp)
